title: token-auth-api
blurb: A token authorizer is accepting lookalike credentials and unrelated scopes. Restore exact authentication and capability checks.
brief:
This service authorizes internal API calls with opaque bearer tokens. A recent incident showed that a token copied from a longer credential was accepted, and callers could pass a scope that merely appeared inside another scope name.

Read the tests as the contract. Tokens and scopes must match exactly, and a failed authorization must raise the documented error.

**Your job:** make every test green without weakening the existing passing behavior.
